jobs.title: Legal Ops Manager
jobs.description:
WHY WORK AT HIGGSFIELD AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

 

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

At Higgsfield, we value people who take ownership and get things done. We’re looking for someone who brings:

 - Strong attention to detail and a high level of responsibility.

 - Proactivity and persistence — you follow through until things are signed and completed.

 - The ability to manage multiple parallel tasks without losing track.

 - Clear communication and the confidence to push stakeholders when needed.

 - A structured, process-driven mindset with a bias toward action.


WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

 - Contract Operations & Execution: Support the full lifecycle of contracts — from preparation to execution. Work closely with legal leads (including Grosu) to finalize agreements, organize signatures, and ensure all documents are properly completed. Proactively follow up with internal teams and external parties to get contracts signed on time.

 - Legal Documentation (KZ Focus): Review, prepare, and manage contracts under Kazakhstani law. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and proper filing of all legal documents.

 - Legal Operations Support: Maintain and organize contract databases and documentation. Track contract statuses, deadlines, and key obligations. Ensure everything is properly archived and easy to retrieve.

 - Cross-functional Coordination: Act as a point of contact between legal, marketing, creative, and operations teams. Help unblock processes by coordinating communication and keeping things moving.

 - Process & System Support: Help build and improve internal legal workflows — from contract tracking to signature processes. Identify inefficiencies and drive improvements.

 - Review/Draft Contracts: Review and edit certain agreements like NDAs and other company templates.

 - Support Trademark Enforcement: Identify and address instances of trademark infringement online.


YOUR MUST HAVES

 - 2–3 years of experience as a paralegal, legal specialist, or in legal operations.

 - Experience in top-tier law/consulting/accounting firms (preferably Ernst & Young) or strong in-house environments (tech companies, startups, or product-driven businesses).

 - Solid understanding of contract workflows and legal documentation.

 - Solid understanding of contract workflows and legal documentation.

 - Experience working with Kazakhstani legal documents is a strong plus.

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 - Ability to proactively follow up and drive processes to completion.

 - Fluent Kazakh, Russian and English.


WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU A STRONG CANDIDATE

 - Experience building automation, such as collecting approvals, sending reminders, generating activity reports, etc.

 - Building AI agents.

 - Experience with Ironclad (contract management software) – a major plus!

 - A law degree.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

At Higgsfield AI, we’re building creative tools for the next generation of storytelling.

We believe AI will fundamentally change how films, videos, images, and interactive experiences are created — not by replacing creativity, but by giving creators entirely new creative leverage.

Our products help people generate cinematic visuals, explore impossible ideas, and build content workflows that previously required entire teams.

We’re a fast-moving, product-obsessed team operating at the intersection of AI, design, and engineering. We prototype aggressively, ship fast, and care deeply about craft.



Who we're looking for

Higgsfield AI is seeking a Strategic Finance professional to help drive financial planning, business insights, and decision support as we continue scaling one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

In this role, you'll partner closely with leaders across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, and Operations to provide financial analysis that informs key business decisions. You'll build models, evaluate investments, improve reporting, and help leadership understand business performance through clear, data-driven insights.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial modeling skills with business judgment, thrives in fast-moving environments, and enjoys partnering cross-functionally to solve complex problems.



What You'll Do

Financial Planning & Analysis

 - Build financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic initiatives and resource planning.

 - Support annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.

 - Analyze business performance and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

 - Develop reporting and dashboards that provide actionable insights to business leaders.

Business Partnership

 - Partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, GTM, and Operations to evaluate investments, initiatives, and business performance.

 - Support financial analyses related to pricing, monetization, product investments, and growth initiatives.

 - Help business teams understand key financial drivers and make informed decisions.

 - Prepare materials and analyses for executive reviews.

Strategic Finance

 - Support short-range and long-range planning, KPI development, and financial reporting.

 - Assist with investor, Board, and financing analyses as needed.

 - Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reporting, and financial systems.

 - Contribute to building scalable financial infrastructure as the company grows.

What We’re Looking For

 - 6–10 years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Corporate Development, or Management Consulting.

 - Experience supporting high-growth technology companies preferred.

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

 - Experience building operating models, forecasts, and business cases.

 - Ability to communicate financial insights clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with SaaS, AI, marketplace, or usage-based business models is a plus.

 - Experience preparing executive presentations and business reviews.

 - Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

 - High ownership, strong attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset.



What we offer:

 - Competitive base salary in USD

 - Equity: participation in the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in the company’s long-term growth.

 - On-site role in our Almaty office (we will relocate you from anywhere).



Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: General Manager, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI https://higgsfield.ai is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We’re building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn’t just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS


A very large share of Higgsfield’s capital goes into compute. GPU procurement, deal economics, the financial planning around it — today that entire function effectively sits on one person’s desk.


We’re not hiring someone to explain the business to the board. We’re hiring someone to drive $100M+ strategic deals end to end: find them, model them, negotiate them, close them, and own what happens after. The financial work matters because it’s how you win a deal and how you know it was worth winning — not because someone needs a deck.


This is the largest line in our cost base and the surface area is enormous, so you’re in company-level decisions from week one. What the role demands is energy and complete ownership. Nobody hands you a process, a pipeline or a mandate here. You take them.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own GPU and compute economics

 - Engage and maintain relationships post-deal close, leading delivery of strategic, co-owned initiatives (e.g., co-marketing, case studies, presence at events/conferences, etc.

 - Become one of the most knowledgeable people in the world on the GPU and AI-compute market: pricing, supply, contract structures, who is building what and at what cost. Through research, and through showing up in person.

 - Source, structure and negotiate compute and infrastructure agreements — capacity commitments, long-term supply, colocation, energy-linked deals.

 - Build the cost models that say whether a deal is good, and challenge the ones that say it is.

Build and challenge the financial picture

 - Build and stress-test P&L and FP&A models at company level.

 - Own forecasting for the largest line in our cost base.

 - Work directly with the CEO and the co-founders on the development strategy and financial planning.

Shape major strategic deals

 - Model the economics of large partnerships and identify where the value actually sits.

 - Translate commercial decisions into a financial story leadership, the board and investors can act on.




REQUIREMENTS

 - McKinsey / BCG / Bain-type background, or equivalent depth from corporate finance, investment banking, infrastructure PE, or a strategic-finance role at a fast-scaling company. Consulting alumni at Engagement Manager / Principal level and above.

 - You can build a three-statement model, an FP&A forecast and a deal case yourself — and find the error in someone else’s.

 - You understand the economics of large strategic deals: capacity, offtake, TCO, capex versus opex, contract structure.

 - At least 3 years working in international markets — at a global company, or in a role where you owned deals or operations across multiple countries.

 - Able to become a genuine domain expert fast, from a standing start, on something technical.

 - Heavy international travel. The GPU market is a relationship market and it does not happen online.

 - Fluent English and Russian.

Nice to have

 - A technical or quantitative undergraduate degree — engineering, physics, applied maths, CS — underneath the commercial track.

 - Procurement, supply-chain or capacity-planning exposure at real scale.

 - Time at a cloud, GPU, data centre, semiconductor or energy company, including on the commercial side.

 - You’ve already made the jump from consulting or banking into an operating role at a startup.




COMING FROM THE COMPUTE SIDE INSTEAD?


If you’ve bought or sold GPU capacity at a cloud, neocloud, data centre or hardware company and you can hold your own on the numbers, this is your role too. We care that you know the market and can move a deal, not which chair you sat in while you learned it.

 




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

 - Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Relocation support for candidates moving from another city or country.

 - A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

 - Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

 - Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, and other office benefits.



Location: Almaty or San Francisco (onsite), with heavy international travel and regular trips to the other hub. Our team works from the office six days per week. We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.



Also hiring: GM, International Partnerships — same seniority, focused on enterprise B2B partnerships and commercial execution across verticals. If your background is commercial rather than analytical, apply there https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/higgsfieldai/a89ac4c2-176b-44c0-9192-f6c16d786ea7 instead.

jobs.title: General Manager, International Partnerships
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI  https://higgsfield.aiis the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We’re building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn’t just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS


Higgsfield has grown roughly 35x in the last twelve months. 390 of the Fortune 500 are already on the product, and the adoption patterns look like nothing that came before — teams find us, adopt us and expand without anyone selling to them. That’s what an AI-native product does, and it’s how the company is built: small teams, no inherited process, decisions made in hours rather than quarters.


The opportunity now is to take that industry by industry. Advertising. Entertainment. Gaming. Retail. E-commerce. Each one is a category where a single person can go in, land the anchor accounts and own the vertical outright.


We’re hiring hunters for that. Not account managers working inbound — people who pick a vertical, build the target list themselves, and take it.



WHAT YOU’LL DO


Own global B2B partnerships

 - Drive the full partnership lifecycle end to end — sourcing, pitching, structuring, negotiating and closing deals with international partners.

 - Build and scale the partnerships pipeline across key markets. You own the target list, not just the deals handed to you.

 - This role travels: partners, in their market, in person.

Lead commercial execution

 - Own revenue targets and deliver against multi-million-dollar goals.

 - Structure complex deals, paid pilots and multi-year strategic agreements.

 - Restart stalled deals because you decided to, not because a process told you to.

Shape strategy and go-to-market

 - Identify high-value use cases with partners and translate Higgsfield’s capabilities into outcomes they can defend inside their own organisation.

 - Design partnership models, pricing structures and GTM approaches from scratch.

 - Switch verticals fast — a media holding this month, a consumer brand the next, a platform after that.

Own accounts and grow them

 - Build durable relationships at C-level with founders, operators and decision-makers.

 - Drive expansion, upsell and new revenue streams inside existing accounts.

 - Carry the full commercial picture: what a deal books and what it costs us to serve.
   


REQUIREMENTS:

 - 7+ years in enterprise sales, business development or partnerships, closing complex multi-million-dollar deals you personally sourced and negotiated.

 - At least 3 years working in international markets — at a global company, or in a role where you owned deals or operations across multiple countries.

 - Experience at a company that scaled aggressively, where daily progress was expected and intensity was normal.

 - You hold both sides of the business in your head. You can say what a partnership earns and what it costs to deliver in the same sentence.

 - Comfortable with almost no structure. You’ll get context and access, not process.

 - Heavy international travel.

 - Fluent English and Russian.

Nice to have

 - Sold into enterprise media, advertising, entertainment or consumer brands.

 - Ran a P&L, a market or a vertical as a GM or country lead.

 - Broke into an international agency or global commercial organisation as a non-native speaker.
   


WHAT WE WEIGH OVER BRAND NAMES


We optimise for intensity and ownership. Three deals you actually built beats a decorated CV of roles you inherited, and a thin LinkedIn profile is not a problem here — several of our strongest people have one. If your best work isn’t visible online, tell us about it in your application.

 - Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Relocation support for candidates moving from another city or country.

 - A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

 - Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

 - Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, and other office benefits.
   

Location: Almaty or San Francisco (onsite), with heavy international travel and regular trips to the other hub. Our team works from the office six days per week. We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.




Also hiring: GM, Strategic Partnerships — same seniority, focused on GPU and compute economics, financial planning and investor-facing strategy. If your background leans consulting or corporate finance, or you come from the cloud and compute world, apply there https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/higgsfieldai/00807c29-404b-4267-9089-40f031bfc6d1 instead.

jobs.title: Head of FP&A
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI? 

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. 

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role:

We’re looking for a highly experienced FP&A leader to build and scale the FP&A function. This person will own budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial planning, while partnering closely with Accounting and budget owners across the business. The ideal candidate has built FP&A processes from the ground up and has experience operating in a high-growth, scaled environment ($1B+ ARR).

What you'll do:

 - Own the company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.

 - Build the FP&A function, processes, reporting, and operating cadence from the ground up.

 - Lead monthly and quarterly budget-to-actual and variance analysis, identifying key drivers and translating them into actionable insights.

 - Partner directly with functional leaders and budget owners on headcount, spend, investment decisions, and ongoing budget management.

 - Work closely with Accounting to ensure actuals, accruals, and financial reporting are accurate and appropriately reflected in forecasts.

 - Develop scalable financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic and operating decisions.

 - Establish clear financial KPIs, dashboards, and reporting for leadership.

 - Improve forecasting accuracy and create greater visibility into business performance as the company scales.

 - Bring structure and financial discipline without creating unnecessary process or slowing down the business.

Requirements:

 - 15+ years of progressive FP&A, strategic finance, or related financial planning experience.

 - Deep, hands-on experience owning budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

 - Experience building or significantly scaling an FP&A function, rather than only operating within an established process.

 - Experience at a company operating at significant scale, ideally $1B+ ARR/revenue.

 - Strong partnership experience with Accounting and cross-functional budget owners.

 - Exceptional financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing, rapidly changing environment.

 - Strong executive communication skills and ability to influence senior leaders.

*Nice to have:

 - Experience in high-growth SaaS, technology, AI, or another rapidly scaling business.

 - Experience supporting a company through hypergrowth and/or major financing, IPO-readiness, or public-company scale.

 - Experience implementing or improving FP&A systems, tooling, and automation.

 - Experience developing headcount and workforce planning models in partnership with Finance and People teams.

Compensation & Benefits

 - We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long-term growth.

 - Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $250,000 - $320,000 depending on experience, skills, scope, and location.

 • Bonus: This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program.

 - Equity: In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks.

 - The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast-moving, and international team.

 - Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office three full days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams.

Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
